messages:
maria.g: Heads up — saw admin-only metrics cards from another workspace briefly in the sidebar after a rapid org switch :eyes:
noah: ugh. repro steps? browser+env?
maria.g: repro on prod (chrome). Steps: 1) open console for org A 2) open Insights sidebar 3) cmd+k quick switch to org B 4) sidebar refreshes but one card shows admin metrics from org A (counts + links)
noah: any console logs or network traces?
maria.g: captured HAR and a snippet: 
```
GET /internal/console/cards?prefetch=true
200  cache-hit
response: { cards:[{id:"traffic-admin", org_id: "org-A", payload: {...}}] }
```
noah: interesting — response contains org_id from previous workspace. sounds like a prefetch + cache TTL race, not auth check failing
lee: +1. likely the prefetch response is cached without workspace-scoping in either the gateway or the cards service. what cache layer did the log show?
maria.g: gateway edge reported `cache-hit` for that exact URL. we don't include x-workspace-id in the request headers for prefetch (old code path).
jing: that matches a bug I saw during the rollout of prefetch isolation — cache key only included `?prefetch` and route. we intended to include `x-workspace-id` but a refactor dropped it.
noah: ok this is leaking admin-level metric summaries into another org's UI. P0?
jing: I'd treat as P0 for now for exposed admin data even if transient. quick mitigation: 1) disable console prefetch for guest/non-admin roles 2) add header to cache key and purge the edge cache for the last 2h keyspace 3) add unit tests in gateway to assert tenant header inclusion
lee: recommended patch: gateway: ensure `cacheKey = route + query + x-workspace-id` and fallback to `no-cache` when workspace header missing. cards service: validate `org_id` in payload against `x-workspace-id` before returning admin cards. add assert in integration tests (rapid switch scenario)
maria.g: I've created an incident doc and temporary rollback flag: https://go/reports/inc-2489 — please add notes.
noah: can someone post the minimal patch? I can review and ship a canary to staging.
jing: I'll open PR in gateway in ~15m. patch will include: 
- include x-workspace-id in Varnish/edge cache key
- force `Cache-Control: no-store` for `?prefetch=true` when role!=admin
- add telemetry tag `console.prefetch.tainted=true` if mismatch found
lee: we'll also add a deterministic test that simulates two back-to-back workspace switches and asserts no card payload contains the wrong org_id
maria.g: telemetry note: console.events showed ~120 tainted responses in the last 24h. we should surface a regression alert if that exceeds 10/day.
noah: good call. add an alert to ops dashboard and mute noisy alerts for initial rollout.
jing: PR: r/12345, added unit + integration tests. tagging @noah @lee for review.
noah: reviewing now. if green I'll promote to canary in region-us-west. :thumbsup:
maria.g: thanks y'all. assigning to jing for the fix, lee for service-side guard, and me to own incident runbook until tomorrow 09:00 PT.
deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: gateway-pr-12345 -> canary-us-west at 1729021800.
lee: post-deploy checklist: purge edge keys, run smoke switch test, verify telemetry counts drop, run synthetic quick-switch 100x.
maria.g: noted. I'll run synthetic and report back within 30m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
